name: Talca

queries.query: Talca Chile official cadastral parcel map GIS catastro visor predial Municipalidad de Talca
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Ilustre Municipalidad de Talca Geoportal, its official municipal territorial-information platform, and the SII national digital property-cartography portal. The municipal Geoportal's current HTML exposes planning zones and one municipal-property layer, but no full public parcel layer or parcel API.

queries.query: Talca Chile catastro visor predial oficial municipal parcelas
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the same municipal Geoportal and the SII Cartografía Digital service. The municipal site identifies CATASTRO within the Dirección de Obras and provides official territorial maps, but the public Geoportal source contains no complete cadastral parcel dataset. SII documentation describes map-based parcel lookup and restricted municipal interoperability access; no anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was obtained.

registryBasis: The Ilustre Municipalidad de Talca is evidenced as the local custodian: its official Geoportal is labelled as the municipality's territorial-information platform, its source identifies SECPLAN and municipal layers, and the official municipal directory identifies CATASTRO within the Dirección de Obras. This is local-custodian evidence, not evidence that a public full parcel service was successfully retrieved.

officialSources.observation: Current public Geoportal source inspected. It contains embedded GeoJSON for PRC zoning and one municipal-property feature with a ROL, plus non-cadastral map overlays; no public full parcel endpoint or parcel schema was present. The embedded municipal-property record was not retained because it includes unsafe owner/title-document fields and is not a general cadastral sample.
Official municipal directory identifies CATASTRO staff within the Dirección de Obras.

Official national agency page links Cartografía Digital, describing map lookup of property location and tax/property attributes. It is general national agency evidence, not a Talca local registry custodian or an anonymous parcel API response.

officialSources.publisher: Ministerio de Vivienda y Urbanismo / IDE
officialSources.observation: Official ArcGIS layer named Talca for Plan Regulador Comunal; metadata is a planning polygon layer in EPSG:4326, not a cadastral parcel layer.

municipalGeoportal.mapCrs: Leaflet geographic display; embedded GeoJSON declares CRS84
municipalGeoportal.safeIdentityCandidate: ROL only for the embedded municipal-property feature, but not retained because the feature is owner-linked municipal property and not a general parcel-service response

minvuPlanningLayer.safeIdentityCandidate: OBJECTID, but this identifies planning polygons rather than cadastral parcels

serviceMetadata.compositeKeyProvenance: No composite cadastral key was observed. SII documentation describes comuna code, manzana and predio components for its cartography, but no Talca feature response was retrieved and no such key is retained.

runtimeAssessment.reason: A local custodian and public municipal map are evidenced, but no anonymous full parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained. Research completion is not source integration, adapter admission, or runtime qualification.

pointBasis: Immutable WUP queue point retained exactly in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate adjustment was made to obtain a parcel hit.
